leftEvidence.title: An unblemished animal, blood, unleavened bread, haste, and passing judgment are commanded

points.label: Passover
points.left: The LORD’s Passover names the hurried household meal.
points.right: “Christ, our Passover” names the sacrificed person.

points.label: Unleavened
points.left: Unleavened bread is eaten with the roasted animal.
points.right: The addressed community is called unleavened and told to clear old yeast.

points.label: Scope
points.left: Households in Egypt face the coming night.
points.right: A Corinthian assembly is addressed through feast imagery.

payload.posture: Keep each Scripture witness intact, inspect what each states, and do not supply a combined sequence the sources do not author.

rightEvidence.title: Christ is named as Passover within an argument about yeast and communal condition

payload.tension: The letter explicitly names Christ as Passover but uses the feast inside a community argument different from Exodus’s narrated night.
payload.title: The first Passover and Corinthian feast language
